scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix app" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.copy-renderer: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('renderer')) fs.rmSync('renderer', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('app/dist', 'renderer', {recursive: true});"
scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && npm run build --prefix app && npm run copy-renderer
